$comment: Role -> permission matrix enforced by the Express API (and mirrored by seed/setup_accounts.py). Roles are mapped from WORKER_MASTER.WORKER_ROLE by an explicit table - never by substring matching. Unknown roles get no role and cannot log in.

permissions.operate_own_tasks: Accept/start/pause/finish own tasks, record milestones, clock in/out, breaks
permissions.submit_self_check: Submit an operator self-check where a gate allows it (never an independent release)
permissions.report_incoming_defect: Report a defect found on a received tank against the prior operation
permissions.view_own_progress: Own progress, labour categories and points ledger
permissions.perform_quality_inspection: Perform an independent gate inspection and record readings/evidence
permissions.release_gate: Release a tank that passed an independent gate inspection
permissions.quality_approval: Decide dispositions (rework/scrap/pending review), approve alternate rework stations, confirm investigation causes
permissions.operational_supervision: Assign/dispatch tasks, confirm absences, view all workers, acknowledge alerts
permissions.approve_transfers: Approve worker transfers and recovery actions
permissions.manage_workers: Create, edit, deactivate workers and accounts; qualifications; rosters
permissions.scenario_control: Create demo sessions, control the simulation clock, use the scenario console, reset to checkpoint
permissions.view_all_workers: Plant-wide workforce views and worker timelines
permissions.material_movements: Record deliveries, shortages and stock movements
permissions.view_audit: View audit log and import validation
permissions.factory_configuration: Fresh factory: configure factory settings, work centres, stations, skills, shifts, equipment, materials, products, routes and checklists
permissions.factory_reset: Fresh factory: preview and run the guarded operational-data reset (only when ALLOW_FACTORY_RESET=true and never in production)
